name: opencode-mpl
description: Code Mode tool that draws matplotlib charts with mpl and shows them in the session.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --target=node --format=esm --external @opencode/plugin --outfile dist/server.js && cp node_modules/mpl/LICENSE dist/mpl-LICENSE && cp node_modules/mpl/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md dist/mpl-THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
